GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-11-30T19:56:25Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Use CommonsChunkPlugin twice on one page
Description: As part of our caching strategy, I have set up a configuration where we have two instances of CommonsChunkPlugin: one for vendor scripts; one for common app code. Now we want to include both on every page. But the generated `vendor.js` and `commons.js` each include the webpack runtime, which doesn't work.

Is there a way to remove the runtime from one of those bundles, or is there a different correct way to do this?
